info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Retail Orders Status-v3-spec
info.description: The Retail Orders Status API enables businesses to query the current status of retail orders efficiently. By offering a comprehensive view of order statuses, this API supports retail managers and customer service teams in monitoring and managing order fulfillment processes. Typical use cases include tracking shipment progress, checking inventory status, and resolving customer inquiries related to order management. This API can integrate seamlessly into retail operations, ensuring real-time updates that facilitate a smooth customer experience.

get.summary: Retrieve the status of an order.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the current status of a specific order. You can check if the order is processing, shipped, delivered, or any other status related to the order lifecycle.

requestBody.description: This request body allows the client to specify the criteria for retrieving the status of orders. It should contain the necessary parameters to filter the order statuses as needed.

200.description: Request completed successfully and status retrieved.

ListRetailOrdersStatusRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for GET operations on order status, expecting a string value.

ListRetailOrdersStatusResponse_200.title: Order Status Response

status.description: The status of the order indicating success or failure.

referenceNumber.description: The unique reference number associated with the order.

resultId.description: The identifier for the result of the operation.

state.description: The current state of the order.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the request in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the order status.

audit.description: Information related to the audit of the order processing.

ListRetailOrdersStatusResponse_200.description: Response schema for retrieving the status of an order.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The user who created the order.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the order was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the order was processed automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Schema containing audit information for order processing.

x-processing-time.description: The time taken (in milliseconds) for the server to process the request.
